changes: Corrected the draft's erroneous 0.0-point label to the official 0.1-point December change.
Separated monthly rate inputs, calculation, measured change, and outcome bucket.
Removed the unnecessary October-rate trend branch.
Downgraded payroll and weekly-claims effects on the unemployment rate to background_hypothesis.
caveats: Payroll employment and unemployment are measured by different surveys.
Late-December weekly claims are a noisy contextual signal and do not identify the monthly-rate change.
